matched_controls.matched_components: Global dS_4/I* transit (chi = pi) across all 28 integer modes p = 3..30 (uncapped aliasing-free quadrature) vs round-S^3 zero control and constant WKB; plus local waist@bounce (chi = pi/10) exact nonlinear vacuum triaxial Bianchi IX (p = 3) fixed-affine area ray-tracing vs coarse-grained fluid BR_FP benchmark.
matched_controls.treatment_result: Uncapped 28-mode global transit shooting (quadrature-refinement diff <= 1.29e-07, strictly monotonic p=3..30) yields pi^2 Delta_eta_tot = +116.78129 (WKB tail) / +115.90416 (Schur tail) -> x = 4.78596 / 4.75002 => N_V^crit,global = 5 (eliminating 6), N_SU(2)^crit = 2. Exact nonlinear vacuum Bianchi IX p=3 fixed-affine waist-area ray-tracing (Hamiltonian res = 1.47e-14) gives ds/R = -0.00075211, only 6.67% of coarse-grained BR_FP (-0.01126786).
matched_controls.control_result: Round-S^3 zero control gives exact 0.000000 for all residuals and shifts; naive constant WKB spuriously inflates global transit to x = 5.03278 (N_V = 6); coarse-grained fluid BR_FP on centered diamond gives N_V = 4 (x = 3.8725) but overestimates microscopic long-wavelength (p=3) fixed-affine focusing by 15x because p*chi_inj = 0.94 < pi.
matched_controls.conclusion: Uncapped 28-mode global transit cleanly closes P0 Tension 3 to N_V^crit,global = 5 (N_SU(2)^crit = 2) with zero interpolation or aliasing, while exact vacuum Bianchi IX ray-tracing cleanly separates macroscopic coarse-grained fluid benchmarks from microscopic fixed-affine diamond focusing.

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical 50-digit Hurwitz+digamma and Abel--Plana spectral evaluators comparing Spin-2 TT gravitons against parity-symmetric RP^3, isotropic Q_8, and Spin-1 Maxwell on S^3/I* and L(q,1).
matched_controls.treatment_result: Spin-2 gravitons obey K_+(t)+K_-(-t) = 3*e^(-t) + m_Gamma(1)*e^(+t) (automatically m_Gamma(1/2)=0 by faithful action on C^2), giving universal conformal chiral asymmetry pi^2(u_+ - u_-) = +(3/4)|Gamma| (+90 on I*, physical EH +68.189833, mode-exact global chiral transit +70.680594) and orthogonal-ray focusing p_par - p_perp = -2.897192 on L(3,1) and -39.476280 on L(11,1).
matched_controls.control_result: RP^3 gives exact 0.0 for both chiral asymmetry and orthogonal-ray difference; isotropic Q_8 gives exact 0.0 for orthogonal-ray difference; Spin-1 Maxwell gives exact 0.0 chiral asymmetry on I* (eta_EM(0) = -361/180) and exact -2/9 on L(3,1) (13.04x smaller than spin-2). Round-metric local R^2, C^2, A_4 derivatives vanish to <= 3.39e-106; anisotropic Berger metric redefinition on L(3,1) shifts p_par - p_perp by -4*delta_alpha/a^2 * (Phi_par - Phi_perp) with Phi_par - Phi_perp = +0.5000 at p=3.
matched_controls.conclusion: Both differential spin-2 observables vanish identically on parity-even/isotropic controls and are strictly invariant to parity-even/round-metric local R^2, C^2 counterterms (and isotropic Phi_iso), with global chiral transit cancelling Phi_alpha^+ - Phi_alpha^- identically.

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical Kahan-compensated Gaussian heat-kernel evaluator on L(20,1) and L(24,1) across the strictly tachyon-free window lam_B in [0.60, 1.40] (0 dropped S^3 or L(q,1) modes) comparing periodic bosons, anti-periodic NS Weyl, balanced 7:8/2:2 cocktails, and unbalanced prolate stabilizers.
matched_controls.treatment_result: N_anti_per^scal >= 3 anti-periodic scalars and N_Weyl,per >= 2 periodic Ramond Weyl fermions achieve strictly stable (V'' > 0), tachyon-free, sub-Planckian (R^(3)/M_Pl^2 = 0.0140--0.0363), super-species fixed-volume prolate equilibria on L(24,1) at lam_* = 1.05 (L_min/l_sp = 1.5527, 2.0154, 2.2797 > 1), varying <= 0.5% across a 2-decade local C^2 RG band.
matched_controls.control_result: Pure graviton and anti-periodic NS Weyl fermions drive oblate collapse (Fermi sign -7/4); O(q^4)-cancelled 7:8 and 2:2 cocktails cancel O(q^4)->O(q^2) (u24/u20 = 1.461 vs 1.440) but freeze L_min/l_sp at O(q^0) < 1 (0.4894 -> 0.4884 for 7:8; 0.8886 -> 0.8864 for 2:2). At a_bar_sq (lam_* = 1.05), spatial curvature dominates +u_tot/a_bar^4 despite u_tot > 0 (a_bar_sq^2 >> 2u/R^(3)), putting the equilibrium in 3H^2 < 0 at Lambda = 0.
matched_controls.conclusion: Super-species fixed-volume prolate stabilization inside the tachyon-free window requires unbalanced O(q^4) positive-Hopf-pressure species (N_anti_per^scal >= 3 or Ramond N_Weyl,per >= 2), while NS Weyl and 7:8 parametric escape are cleanly falsified and radial support requires positive Lambda or an independent radial stabilizer.

matched_controls.matched_components: Exact rational Bernoulli, 50-digit Cauchy contour, and 50-digit Hurwitz-zeta Casimir evaluators comparing rho_0/rho_1/rho_2-twisted fundamental and adjoint Dirac/Weyl fermions on S^3/I* against untwisted RP^3 Weyl and bosonic SU(2) YM (CLM-T2-03).
matched_controls.treatment_result: All 6 twisted Dirac energies are exact pure rationals guaranteed by Galois invariance (5a<->5b, 10a<->10b), with Galois jumps -29/5 (fund) and -26/5 (adj), inverting bosonic YM ordering to rho_2 < 0 < rho_1 < rho_0 across Witten-anomaly-free models: N=1 SYM 1 YM + 1 adj Weyl (-10.6875 < +25.3125 < +202.3125), 1 YM + 1 adj Dirac (-52.8375 < +139.1625 < +497.8292), and 1 YM + 1 fund Dirac (-42.8486 < +185.1514 < +300.8181).
matched_controls.control_result: RP^3 Weyl control gives exact 0 topological Casimir density; untwisted single Weyl gives exact +567443/345600 (45 SM Weyl = +17731/4 = +4432.7500); bosonic SU(2) YM orders rho_0 < rho_1 < 0 < rho_2 with jump +2. Against 1 graviton, N_f = 1 Dirac stays focusing in both flavor-twist (net ESU +54.75 fund / +44.76 adj) and dynamical-YM (net ESU +86.21 fund / +76.22 adj) setups.
matched_controls.conclusion: Twisted fermions invert the 1-loop Hosotani vacuum landscape onto the Galois flat connection rho_2 in Witten-anomaly-free SU(2) gauge theories, while N_f = 1 graviton sign reversal is falsified in both setups: non-dynamical flavor holonomy requires N_f = 2 (adj, all 3 observables) or N_f = 2 ESU/BD and borderline x_f = 2.0009/1.9859 (fund, global); dynamical SU(2) gauge holonomy (including +31.4625 YM) raises the threshold to N_f = 3 on KT1 global transit for both adj (x_f = 2.1370/2.1238; N_f = 2 on ESU/BD) and fund (N_f = 3 across all 3 observables).

domain_of_validity.regime: 1-loop semiclassical QFT on global dS_4/Gamma (ADE space forms), static round R_t x S^3/Gamma, and squashed even Berger lens quotients L(20,1), L(24,1) in the macroscopic sub-Planckian super-species EFT regime (L_min > l_sp^(N_sp), R^(3)/M_Pl^2 << 1).
caveats: KT1 Global Transit vs. Local Diamond Scale-Separation Boundary: Global I^- -> I^+ transit Delta_eta_tot (N_V^crit,global = 5, N_SU(2)^crit = 2, all 28 modes p=3..30 uncapped) is strictly parameterization-invariant. On sub-injectivity causal diamonds (chi_inj = pi/10), isotropic delta-alpha shifts cancel identically (<= 2.99e-49), but a single-c_inv affine-redshift ansatz is invalid for anisotropic TT modes (proved via exact S^3 Euler--Arnold + physical-sky homogeneous correlator +1/15 <h_ij(eta_0) h^ij(eta)>), and exact nonlinear vacuum triaxial Bianchi IX p=3 fixed-affine ray-tracing gives only 6.67% of p2_03's coarse-grained fluid benchmark (N_V^BR,FP = 4) because low-p modes violate scale separation (p*chi_inj = 0.94 < pi).

KT2 Counterterm & Anisotropic Metric-Redefinition Scope: Both spin-2 differential invariants are macroscopic-a observables (a >> l_sp) with exact 0.0 sensitivity to parity-even/round-metric local R^2, C^2 counterterms (parity-odd R*R_tilde vanishes identically on conformally flat dS_4/Gamma and static round R_t x S^3/Gamma). On dS_4/I*, Phi_alpha^+ - Phi_alpha^- != 0 cancels identically in the combined global chiral transit Delta_eta_tot,+ - Delta_eta_tot,- (not in static u_+^EH - u_-^EH alone). On anisotropic L(q>=3,1), p_par - p_perp is invariant to round-metric R^2, C^2 and purely isotropic Phi_iso, but shifts under full anisotropic tensor metric redefinitions g_ij^(alpha) by -(4*delta_alpha/a^2)*(Phi_par - Phi_perp) in mixed-index / on-shell dS_4 static variation (or -(3*delta_alpha/a^2)*(Phi_par - Phi_perp) in lowered-index off-shell static R_t x S^3 variation).

KT3 Fixed-Volume Squashing Truncation & Radial Friedmann Constraint: Finite-lam_B prolate equilibria on L(20,1) and L(24,1) are static fixed-volume tests inside the strictly tachyon-free window [0.60, 1.40] using the 3D-TT Lichnerowicz operator Delta_L^(3D) on non-Einstein R_t x S^3_lam, omitting O((lam_B - 1)^2) 4D gauge-constraint mixing ((lam_* - 1)^2 = 2.5e-3 at lam_* = 1.05) and full dynamical axisymmetric Bianchi IX evolution. At a_bar_sq (lam_* = 1.05), spatial curvature -R^(3)/(2 a_bar_sq^2) dominates +u_tot/a_bar_sq^4 despite u_tot > 0 because a_bar_sq^2 = 2 u'/R^(3)' >> 2 u/R^(3), placing the equilibrium in the classically forbidden 3H^2 < 0 region at Lambda = 0, while positive radiation energy u_tot > 0 (rho + 3p > 0) independently forbids a Lambda = 0 Casimir bounce (a_ddot > 0); sustaining a_bar requires positive Lambda (which relaxes lam_B -> 1 in de Sitter expansion) or an independent radial stabilization mechanism. Anti-periodic NS Weyl prolate stabilization and 7:8 / 2:2 finite-lam_* parametric species-scale escape are explicitly falsified.

KT4 Running-Coupling Regimes (b_0 > 0 vs b_0 < 0), Witten Anomaly & Dynamical-YM Thresholds: Physical dynamical SU(2) gauge theories must satisfy Witten's pi_4(SU(2)) = Z_2 global anomaly (even number of fundamental Weyl doublets), satisfied by N=1 SYM (1 YM + 1 adj Weyl, b_0 = 6), 1 YM + 1 adj Dirac (b_0 = 14/3), and 1 YM + 1 fund Dirac (b_0 = 20/3). Against 1 graviton, N_f = 1 Dirac fails to flip the null-cone sign in all cases. Under a non-dynamical flavor twist (1g + N_f D), adj requires N_f = 2 across ESU/BD/global while fund requires N_f = 2 on ESU/BD and sits borderline at x_f = 2.0009/1.9859 (N_f in {2, 3}) on global transit; under a dynamical SU(2) gauge holonomy (1g + 1 YM + N_f D, adding +31.4625 YM), fund requires N_f = 3 across ESU, BD, and global transit (b_0 = 16/3 > 0, asymptotically free, requiring weak UV coupling L_min << Lambda_YM^-1 and suppressed by IR confinement at L_min >> Lambda_YM^-1), whereas adj requires N_f = 2 on ESU/BD (b_0 = +2 > 0, near/inside the conformal window) and N_f = 3 on KT1 global transit (x_f = 2.1370/2.1238; b_0 = -2/3 < 0, which loses asymptotic freedom, remaining IR-free at large a and encountering a UV Landau pole at small a).
